title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.7
body_markdown:
*released Nov 14th, 2023*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.7

### Security Advisories Addressed

* [**CVE-2023-36038**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36038) A vulnerability exists in ASP.NET IIS where a remote unauthenticated user can issue specially crafted requests to a .NET application which may result in denial of service.
* [**CVE-2023-36049**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36049) An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists in .NET where untrusted URIs provided to System.Net.WebRequest.Create can be used to inject arbitrary commands to backend FTP servers.
* [**CVE-2023-36558**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36558) A security feature bypass vulnerability exists in ASP.NET where an unauthenticated user is able to bypass validation on blazor server forms which could trigger unintended actions.
* [**CVE-2023-36042**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36042) A denial of service vulnerability exists in Visual Studio where a malformed decorated name can result in an infinite loop.
